source.document: REVLIMID (lenalidomide) capsules, full prescribing information, Revised: 3/2023, DailyMed set ID 5fa97bf5-28a2-48f1-8955-f56012d296be

file_reviewed.file: 20260806_5fa97bf5-28a2-48f1-8955-f56012d296be.pdf (81 pages, DailyMed print dated 2026-08-06, text layer)

source.storage: Supplied by the platform owner; kept on the owner's computer, not committed.
source.extraction: AI-assisted. Every quote was checked against text extracted from the file (pdftotext, whitespace normalised); Table 3 values were transcribed from the same text. Independent review pending.
source.currency: Revision 3/2023 as printed on 6 August 2026. The DailyMed SPL version number is not printed in the file.

combination_starting_dose.schedule: once daily, days 1-21 of repeated 28-day cycles, with dexamethasone
combination_starting_dose.quote: The recommended starting dose of REVLIMID is 25 mg orally once daily on Days 1-21 of repeated 28-day cycles in combination with dexamethasone.

combination_dose_floor.quote: Do not dose below 2.5 mg daily

maintenance_starting_dose.schedule: once daily continuously, days 1-28 of repeated 28-day cycles; may increase to 15 mg after 3 cycles if tolerated
maintenance_starting_dose.quote: The recommended starting dose of REVLIMID is 10 mg once daily continuously (Days 1-28 of repeated 28-day cycles) until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

renal_dose_adjustments.table: Table 3: Dose Adjustments for Patients with Renal Impairment (section 2.6, PDF pages 11-12); renal function by Cockcroft-Gault

rows.mm_combination: 5 mg once daily; on dialysis days, after dialysis
rows.mm_maintenance_and_mds: 2.5 mg once daily; on dialysis days, after dialysis

renal_dose_adjustments.average_daily_dose_note: mm_combination_average_daily_mg is derived by the platform (15 mg every other day = 7.5 mg per day on average); the label states only the regimen.
renal_dose_adjustments.upper_bound_note: The label's first row is CLcr 30 to 60 mL/min. The platform's pinned regulatory-context note (lenalidomide_reference_exposure_v1.json, from Chen 2017) describes the dose reductions as applying below 50 mL/min. The two sources use different thresholds; this extract records the label's.

escalation.quote: For CLcr of 30 to 60 mL/min, consider escalating the dose to 15 mg after 2 cycles if the patient tolerates the 10 mg dose of lenalidomide without dose-limiting toxicity.

statement_8_6.quote: Adjust the starting dose of REVLIMID based on the creatinine clearance value and for patients on dialysis [see Dosage and Administration (2.6)].

linearity.quote: The single and multiple dose pharmacokinetic disposition of lenalidomide is linear with AUC and Cmax values increasing proportionally with dose.

protein_binding.quote: In vitro [14C]-lenalidomide binding to plasma proteins is approximately 30%.

design.quote: Eight subjects with mild renal impairment (creatinine clearance (CLcr) 50 to 79 mL/min calculated using Cockcroft-Gault), 9 subjects with moderate renal impairment (CLcr 30 to 49 mL/min), 4 subjects with severe renal impairment (CLcr < 30 mL/min), and 6 patients with end stage renal disease (ESRD) requiring dialysis were administered a single 25 mg dose of REVLIMID.

result.quote: Patients with moderate and severe impairment had a 3-fold increase in half-life and a 66% to 75% decrease in drug clearance compared to healthy subjects.

dialysis.quote: Patients on hemodialysis (n=6) had an approximate 4.5-fold increase in half-life and an 80% decrease in drug clearance compared to healthy subjects.

renal_study.group_count_note: The label lists 3 healthy subjects with normal renal function. The EMA assessment table pinned as the platform's reference (renal_pk_group_evidence_v1.json) reports n = 7 in the normal group of CC-5013-PK-001. Not reconciled here.

mild.quote: Mild hepatic impairment (defined as total bilirubin > 1 to 1.5 times upper limit normal (ULN) or any aspartate transaminase greater than ULN) did not influence the disposition of lenalidomide.

moderate_severe.quote: No pharmacokinetic data is available for patients with moderate to severe hepatic impairment.

other_intrinsic_factors.quote: Other Intrinsic Factors: Age (39 to 85 years), body weight (33 to 135 kg), sex, race, and type of hematological malignancies (MM, MDS or MCL) did not have a clinically relevant effect on lenalidomide clearance in adult patients.

renal_caution.quote: Since elderly patients are more likely to have decreased renal function, care should be taken in dose selection. Monitor renal function.

efficacy_mm_prior_therapy.quote: No differences in efficacy were observed between patients over 65 years of age and younger patients.
